entry.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
entry.summary: We introduce a method for training AI systems to be helpful, harmless, and honest using a constitution of principles and AI-generated feedback.

entry.title: Claude: A Large Language Model for Responsible AI
entry.summary: We present Claude, a large language model trained using reinforcement learning from human feedback and constitutional AI techniques.

entry.title: Scaling Monosemanticity: Extracting Interpretable Features from Claude
entry.summary: We apply dictionary learning to Claude 3 Sonnet and find millions of interpretable features in a middle layer, demonstrating that sparse autoencoders can scale to frontier AI systems.
